skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply knowledge in economic management and organizational management to analyze decisions and situations in economic management.
Demonstrate effective problem-solving skills in economic and organizational management contexts.
Develop systematic thinking to understand complex economic and organizational issues.
Improve communication and presentation skills in professional settings.
Analyze organizational structures and functions effectively.
Manage economic policies and practices in governmental and organizational contexts.
Work independently and manage resources effectively.
Adapt to changes and continuously learn in professional environments.
Demonstrate ethical responsibility and social accountability in professional roles.
